mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) compresses discount rates and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. This signal is active whenever the rate remains low.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low-rate periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate below 4.5% signals a tightening labor market that boosts corporate profits and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when UNRATE falls below 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals robust economic expansion, which typically precedes positive S&P 500 returns. The interaction effect is stronger than either series alone.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months where both PAYEMS and RSAFS are rising above their 3-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising above 0.5% for 3 consecutive months), the S&P 500 experiences negative returns over the next 20 days due to higher discount rates and reduced liquidity.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months during the tightening cycle.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level above 700,000 units signals strong consumer demand and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when HOUST exceeds 700,000 units.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 95.0 signals a weakening manufacturing sector and potential economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when INDPRO falls below 95.0.

mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) compresses discount rates and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in low-rate periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals robust demand across multiple sectors, which typically precedes positive S&P 500 returns. The interaction effect is stronger than either series alone.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months where both RSAFS and HOUST are above their 3-month moving averages.
